name: Dark Abyss
source:
Investigation comes to uncovering existence of Dark Abyss weapon auction. John infiltrates this criminal group. In the meantime, Mars faces existence of a terrible fatal virus.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
调查最终揭开了“黑暗深渊”武器拍卖会的存在。约翰潜入这个犯罪集团。与此同时，马尔斯得知了一种可怕致命病毒的存在。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-april-2001-mizuiro.html]vndbreview[/url]]
